summary: Fewer false alarms when Microsoft is busy, lower log costs, and a simpler managed tenant install.

fixes.title: Microsoft throttling no longer sends failure alerts
fixes.text: When Microsoft briefly slows a job that changed nothing, it shows as throttled and retries. You are mailed only if it stays stuck for 12 runs or 6 hours.

fixes.title: Quieter logs, lower Log Analytics cost
fixes.text: Repeating messages are now logged once and then daily, so your Log Analytics bill drops. Errors are always logged, and full logs stay under Jobs > Logs.

fixes.title: Managed tenant install needs no extra tools
fixes.text: A managed tenant install and its downloadable setup scripts no longer need the Azure CLI, and the admin account prefix is now optional.

fixes.title: Updates finish more reliably
fixes.text: The automatic update waits for a busy engine before sizing it, records the release it applied correctly, and no longer reports a false updater problem.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: PIM Manager reports in to Invardia every 4 hours, every script prints its name and version first, and large tenants see less load from daily activity reads.
